title: Qualify descriptor snapshot coverage
requires: Host fixture and one advertised reference solver
scope: Exercise record-time ownership for flat and nested host descriptor arrays across command families.
acceptance: Caller storage mutation after successful recording cannot change later execution for every descriptor-shape class.
Rejected or allocation-failed recording retains no caller pointer, and command-buffer reset releases owned snapshots.
evidence: PASS Windows D3D12 NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1080 descriptor profile 20/20: flat transfer arrays and nested cloth descriptor/vertex/index/mass arrays survived caller mutation and free; rejection and reset preserved prior state.
PASS WSL GCC 13.3 host fixture 20/20: deterministic nested recording OOM latched, retained no caller storage and recovered after command-buffer reset; adjacent host lifecycle slice passed 5/5.
PASS Visual Studio 18 and GCC 13.3 builds; D3D12 lifecycle slice passed 3 with 3 capability skips; generated API references and 19 roadmap unit tests passed.
